title: PresenceCacheResource.record has no max size or TTL
description:
The resource docstring calls /presence/cache a table of recently-heard peers. record() inserts every addr into an unbounded dict and GET/Observe serializes the whole table. evict/purge_older_than exist but nothing invokes them and there is no cap.

A caller that records overheard addrs (spoofed or many) grows memory and Observe payloads without bound. WaypointsResource and MessagesResource cap at 100. Distinct from existing bead worker6-7gk6 (decoder nodes-array size in from_mapping).

File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/presence.py PresenceCacheResource.record / snapshot / render_get
acceptance_criteria: Cache has a documented max entry count and/or default TTL. record() evicts oldest or refuses beyond the cap. GET payload stays bounded. Tests cover overflow and purge.
